owners.actions: native HTML links/buttons; footer-specific state adapter

coverage.scope: entire footer bounds in the inspected document
coverage.method: Exact clipped union of DOM Range line rectangles; control/media/decorative bounds reported separately.
limitations: Text is line-box area, not literal glyph ink. Logos and decorative wordmark are excluded.
Without text is not empty: it includes controls, media, decoration and backgrounds.
Controls, media and decoration may overlap text or each other; do not add their percentages.
Free layout excludes functional text, controls and media; decorative backgrounds are not occupied content.
Values depend on content, font, width and configuration; they are observations, not ideal percentages.

provenance.redistribution: local review only; ignored by Git

layout_space.method: 40x28 cell sampling outside visible text line boxes, actions and avatars; decorative backgrounds excluded

surface_coverage.method: DOM hit-test and composited solid CSS backgrounds; photos/gradients unresolved, not pixel color analysis

limitations: Snapshot in CSS px, not human taste or a symmetry score.
Space uses line/control rectangles, not glyph pixels or ideal spacing.
Photo/gradient contrast is unknown; inspect the rendered backdrop.
Color coverage is sampled CSS surface coverage, not image color percentages.
